notes.title: Free Birthdays DLC Patch, Including Prinny, Dood! + Future Patch Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308631/8e4ac767fcf664362845e89c6c7f1de5ff109328.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone!

We're happy to announce a new [i]Birthdays the Beginning[/i] DLC patch that will allow players to access 6 DLC sets and a Prinny Doll DLC for free! Please note that all items are strictly ornamental.

[u]DLC Descriptions:[/u]
[list][*][b]Prinny Doll[/b] - Includes the ornamental "Prinny Doll" item, a tribute to the beloved [i]Disgaea[/i] mascot.
[*][b]Kunio and Riki Set[/b] - The prolific high school punks burst onto the scene in Birthdays the Beginning. The Kunio and Riki Set contains the characters Kunio and Riki. 
[*][b]World Flag Set[/b] - The World Flag Set contains the national flags of the following countries: America, Canada, UK, Italy, Netherlands, Sweden, Spain, Germany, France, Russia, South Korea, China, and Japan.
[*][b]World Monument Set[/b] - The World Monument Set contains the following items: Pyramid, Stonehenge, Moai Statue, Totem Pole, Obelisk, and Chichen Itza.
[*][b]Zen Garden Set[/b] - The Zen Garden contains the following items: Pond & Bridge, Stone Lantern, Large Bushes, Fence, Gate, and Sozu.
[*][b]Cube Creator DX Set[/b] - The [i]Cube Creator DX Set[/i] contains the following items: Cube & Brothers, Cube & Animals, and Cube & Monsters.
[*][b]Desert Rat Squad Set[/b] - Desert Rat Squad Set contains the Desert Rat and Devil Cat items.
[/list]
Lastly, we'd like to announce upcoming patches that will fix the following issues that the community has been vocal about:
[olist]
[*]FPS issues & Cursor Lag
[*]Polishing control schemes for keyboard and controller users
[/olist]
We are looking to provide more updates by [b]September[/b]. 

We appreciate everyone's patience with our patches and our devs are working hard to get these issues fixed.

Thanks again for everyone's support!

Best,
NISA Team

notes.title: New default branch to help with graphical issues / game slowdown
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We have put up a new default branch of the game.
The main fix in this branch is the ability to tinker with graphical options. 
These options can be accessed from here: 

1. Start new game or load save data. 
2. Press Esc Key to open sub menu
3. Choose Graphics Settings. 

Here you will be able to change:

Shadow Setting
Draw Quality Setting
Background Setting

As I mentioned in my previous post I was able to double the FPS performance by lowering these settings, so those of you with FPS issues please give this a try. 

We are still working very hard to make this game more optimized for PC so hang on tight for more updates. 

Thank you.

Prinny Toshi

We made an announcement about a week ago (8 days to be exact) saying we added keyboard key configuration options. 

What I (Prinny Toshi) overlooked was that, by following the steps below there are additional graphics options not in the options menu.

We are still working very hard to make this game more optimized for PC so hang on tight for more updates. 

Thank you... dood.

notes.title: Official Announcement Regarding Playability and Functionality
notes.notes:
The Improvement to the Controls, Graphics, and Overall Playability of the game.

Thank you all for either playing or being interested in the game Birthdays the Beginning. 
We garnered tons of attention by releasing this game on PC at the same time as console (PS4) but we at NISA feel that we let many people down. 

We have received tons of feedback regarding Birthdays the Beginning and we feel the 2 reasons below are the biggest issues with this game so far. 
1.	The controls of the game are not optimized for PC
2.	The graphical aspect of the game is not optimized for PC. 

Currently we are in very close contact with the developers in order to fix these issues but at this very moment we cannot guarantee a date these issues will be fixed, but we will do our best to resolve the issue.
That being said, once we know an exact date we will definitely announce it here. 

For further details, see our Discussions post, which has specific instructions on a temporary fix for Radeon and Nvidia graphics cards:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/525700/discussions/0/2741975115067646379/

notes.title: Wot I Think: Birthdays the Beginning
notes.notes: Birthdays The Beginning [official site] is a sandbox evolution game from Harvest Moon creator Yasuhiro Wada. The aesthetic is somewhere between Harvest Moon, Viva Pinata and a sugarcraft workshop. On paper it looks like the exact sort of thing I’d love a biology-themed sim with collectible and ADORABLE lifeforms including ferns, velociraptors and turtles. In practice it can’t seem combine the ingredients into a satisfying enough dish. Here’s Wot I Think: … [visit site to read more]

notes.notes: While checking some 2017 release dates for a feature it looks like Birthdays The Beginning [official site] – the sandbox sim from the creator of Harvest Moon where you can create and curate worlds full of plants and creatures – has slipped back a couple of months. The game was previously scheduled for March, 2017 but is now pegged for May. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Birthdays The Beginning; a new game from Harvest Moon creator Yasuhiro Wada
notes.notes:
Birthdays The Beginning [official site] is a new project, releasing 7 March (that’s the NA release, EU will be 10 March), by Harvest Moon creator Yasuhiro Wada. It has been nagging at the edges of my gaming radar for a little while now, simply by dint of game images showing off adorable-looking dinosaurs and pictures of the game as a real-life miniature scene but it was only in the last few days that I learned what the game actually is. It’s an environment nurturing sim where you try to spawn and evolve different lifeforms in order to capture them.

Somewhere between Pokemon and Viva Pinata is how I’m thinking of it right now, partly for the gameplay elements, but also for the emotion and the aesthetic of the latter particularly. But to find out more I sat down with Wada-san (and an incredibly helpful translator) as well as tuning in to a Twitch broadcast showing off the main game loops. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Harvest Moon Creator s Sandbox Birthdays Hitting PC
notes.notes:
The next game from Harvest Moon creator Yasuhiro Wada, named Birthdays the Beginning [official site], is coming our way next year. Birthdays is a cute little sandbox about carving a teensy Minecraft-y world out of a cube in space to develop and support an ecosystem of everything from plants to dinosaurs. A console released was announced a while back, and now we know it’ll be on PC too. Have a peek at its cubeworlds in this Japanese trailer:
